mapper.sql: mo.id, mo.merchant_id, mo.operator_member_id, mo.active_operator_member_id, mo.role_code, mo.status, mo.accepted_at, mo.revoked_by_member_id, mo.revoked_at, mo.revoke_reason, mo.version, mo.create_time, mo.update_time
mapper.select: select from merchant_operator mo where mo.active_operator_member_id = #{operatorMemberId} limit 1
select from merchant_operator mo where mo.active_operator_member_id = #{operatorMemberId} limit 1 for update
select from merchant_operator mo where mo.id = #{id} for update

select , um.nickname as operator_nickname, um.avatar as operator_avatar from merchant_operator mo left join ums_member um on um.id = mo.operator_member_id where mo.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by case when mo.status = 'ACTIVE' then 0 else 1 end, mo.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_operator (merchant_id, operator_member_id, role_code, status, accepted_at, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{operatorMemberId}, #{roleCode}, #{status}, #{acceptedAt}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update merchant_operator set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_by_member_id = null, revoked_at = now(), revoke_reason = #{revokeReason}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
